title: Anyone can generate a game now. How do we find the good ones?
author: ZirconGloomHymn
selftext:
Do you ever click on those little games in your feed?

Feels like there's a lot of quickly made AI stuff now. With sites like Rosebudai and [binkbink.ai](http://binkbink.ai) letting people make games from a prompt, I wonder how many people actually play theirs before publishing.

I don't mind a game using AI. I'd just hate for something someone spent months fixing to get buried under a bunch of untested games.

Should the sites check them first, or is that what player ratings are for?

Someone has to try the broken ones before they get a rating, though.

comments.author: riccioverde11
comments.body: Dude, slop sucks. Making a (good) game is still hard.
